summary_en: The company will cancel 992,448 shares (5.60% of issued shares before cancellation) effective December 30, 2026, contingent on shareholder approval of a proposed stock split at the November 27, 2026 extraordinary general meeting.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 27, 2026, the board of directors of Japan Property Management Center Co., Ltd. resolved to cancel 992,448 treasury shares, representing 5.60% of the issued share capital prior to cancellation. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on December 30, 2026. Following cancellation, the company will have 16,733,152 issued shares outstanding.

The cancellation is conditional upon shareholder approval of a proposed stock split (1:1 stock consolidation) at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for November 27, 2026, with an effective date of January 4, 2027. The treasury shares to be cancelled represent the entirety of self-held shares as of October 14, 2026.
